bioavailability_tips: Pair iron-rich meals with Vitamin C (lemon, amla, guava, orange) to triple non-heme iron absorption.
Avoid tea, coffee, and calcium-rich foods within 1 hour of an iron-rich meal - tannins and calcium inhibit iron uptake.
Soak and sprout legumes, and ferment batters (idli/dosa) to break down phytates that bind iron.
